usage: speechloom gui [-h] [--port PORT] [--allow-root ALLOW_ROOT]
                      [--max-upload-mb MAX_UPLOAD_MB] [--no-browser]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --port PORT
  --allow-root ALLOW_ROOT
                        Let the interface use local paths below this root
                        (repeatable)
  --max-upload-mb MAX_UPLOAD_MB
  --no-browser          Do not open the interface in a browser
